title: 第23章 昊天七天期限杨婵去砸场子了第24章 杨婵戏玉鼎
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
;;
凌霄宝殿。
今日朝会与往日不同，殿上诸神列坐，比平时多了两倍不止。
平日里那些闭门清修的上仙、星君、真人，今日来了大半，他们有的是听到了风声，有的是被紧急召来，有的纯粹是来看热闹的。
金乌大帝陨落的消息，已经传遍了三十三天。
这个消息像一颗石子投入平静的湖面，在天庭激起了千层浪，诸神议论纷纷，猜测着到底发生了什么。
“肃静——”
太白金星拂尘一扫，殿内安静下来。
王母坐在凤椅上，脸色铁青，一言不发，此事是她王母吃了瘪，不知道昊天搞这么大阵仗干啥，存心是要落了她的颜面吗？
很快太白金星就是眉头一皱，只见天蓬元帅卞庄火急火燎的入了凌霄宝殿。
但这个时候卞庄的模样有一些凄惨，卞庄黑铁甲胄破了好几处，左肩的护甲不见了，头盔也不知道丢在了哪里，头发散乱，脸色发青。
好家伙，卞庄这厮还真是一个好演员，刚才在九重天你还是好好的，眨眼间就将自己弄成了狼狈不堪的样子。
殿内诸神的目光齐刷刷地落在他身上，然而卞庄面不改色，随后来到了丹墀之下，单膝跪地，哭诉道：“卞庄拜见天帝，王母娘娘。”
“金乌大帝，因公殉职了，五千天兵天将下凡，无一生还，臣愧对天庭！”
卞庄面色悲戚，看上去就像是经历了一场大悲剧一样。
王母冷哼一声，道：“金乌大帝死了，天兵天将也阵亡了，你怎么活着回来了？”
卞庄站起身来，脸上一脸痴呆，只是象征性的摇了摇头，像是遭受到了什么沉重的打击。
看到卞庄这一副死猪不怕开水烫的样子，王母道：“金乌大帝究竟是怎么死的，死在了谁手中？”
“不知道。”
卞庄一语惊人，一句不知道，让凌霄宝殿内沸腾了起来。

王母的脸色更是难看到了极点，“你一句不知道，就想搪塞过去吗？你以为本宫那么好糊弄？”
卞庄不敢抬头，只是道：“臣只记得，跟着金乌大帝下界到了那杨家村，看到那驸马爷坐在河边钓鱼，然后就是那金光一闪.....等到臣醒来的时候，只是隐隐约约听到了金乌大帝的惨叫声，已不见了金乌大帝的踪影。”
“臣不知道发生了什么，也不知道是谁动的手，臣只知道，还不跑命就没了。”
好家伙，太白金星暗暗看了一眼卞庄，这家伙装疯卖傻还真有一套。
没办法里面外面都得罪不起，只有这一招才能明哲保身。
凌霄宝殿之内议论纷纷。
“金光一闪就什么都不知道了？”
“天蓬元帅虽然不是顶尖高手，可也是太乙金仙的修为，怎么可能连对手都没看清就昏过去了？”
“那金乌大帝可是大罗金仙，一身法力强横无比。这下界之人究竟是使用了什么手段，还是有心之人算计我天庭？”
......
然而王母只关心那三个刺耳至极的字眼。
驸马爷。
王母厉声道：“瑶姬违背天条，嫁给了一个凡人，你竟称呼此人为驸马爷？”
卞庄猛然抬起头，意识到自己说漏嘴了，对着自己嘴巴就是轻轻一巴掌，“俺卞庄说错话了，王母娘娘责罚。”
这个时候昊天开口了，道：“好了，天蓬此番下界似也受了不少的伤害，就不要为难他了，你可曾见了那凡人杨易出手？”
卞庄摇了摇头，直白的说道：“不知道。”
王母的脸色更难看了，她冷冷地扫了卞庄一眼，那眼神像刀子一样，刮得卞庄后背发凉。
“一问三不知，天蓬元帅，你让本宫说你什么好？”
王母声音里带着毫不掩饰的怒意。
就在这个时候，一个宫女来到了王母身边，传了一句声音，王母一听，眼神逐渐变得凌厉了起来，“天帝，听说那瑶姬已上了天庭？”

昊天并没有隐瞒的意思，直言道：“此事不假，她已被朕囚禁在了披香殿中。”

Lingxiao Palace.
Today's court meeting was different from the past. There were more than twice as many gods sitting in the hall than usual.
On weekdays, most of the immortals, star kings, and real people who usually practice behind closed doors came here today. Some of them heard the news, some were summoned urgently, and some just came to watch the fun.
The news of the death of the Golden Crow Emperor has spread throughout the thirty-three days.
This news was like a pebble thrown into a calm lake, causing thousands of waves in the heaven. The gods were talking about it, wondering what happened.
"Quiet——"
Taibai Jinxing swept away the dust, and the palace became quiet.
The Queen Mother was sitting on the phoenix chair, her face was livid and she said nothing. This matter was her Queen Mother's failure. I wonder why Haotian was engaging in such a big battle. Did he deliberately want to lose her face?
Soon Taibai Jinxing frowned and saw Marshal Bian Zhuang entering the Lingxiao Palace in a hurry.
But at this time, Bian Zhuang looked a little miserable. Bian Zhuang's black iron armor was broken in several places, the armor on his left shoulder was missing, his helmet was thrown away unknown where, his hair was messy, and his face was blue.
Good guy, Bian Zhuang is really a good actor. Just now you were fine in Jiuchongtian, but in the blink of an eye you turned yourself into a miserable state.
The eyes of all the gods in the palace fell on him, but Bian Zhuang's expression did not change. Then he came to the foot of Danqi, knelt down on one knee, and cried: "Bian Zhuang pays homage to the Emperor of Heaven and the Queen Mother."
"The Golden Crow Emperor died in the line of duty. Five thousand heavenly soldiers and generals descended to earth. None of them survived. I am ashamed to face the heaven!"
Bian Zhuang looked sad, as if he had experienced a great tragedy.
The Queen Mother snorted coldly and said: "The Golden Crow Emperor is dead, and the heavenly soldiers and generals have also died in battle. How did you come back alive?"
Bian Zhuang stood up with a look of dementia on his face. He just shook his head symbolically, as if he had suffered a heavy blow.
Seeing Bian Zhuang's appearance of a dead pig that was not afraid of boiling water, the Queen Mother said: "How did the Golden Crow Emperor die, and by whose hands?"
"I don't know."
Bian Zhuang's shocking words and unknown words made the Lingxiao Palace boil with excitement.
The Queen Mother's face was even more ugly, "You don't know a word, so you just want to prevaricate? Do you think I am so easy to fool?"
Bian Zhuang did not dare to raise his head and just said: "I only remember that I followed the Golden Crow Emperor down to the Yangjia Village and saw the Prince Consort sitting by the river fishing, and then there was a flash of golden light... When I woke up, I could only vaguely hear the screams of the Golden Crow Emperor, and there was no trace of the Golden Crow Emperor."
"I don't know what happened, and I don't know who did it. I only know that if I don't run away, I will die."
Good guy, Taibai Jinxing glanced at Bian Zhuang secretly. This guy is really good at pretending to be crazy and acting stupid.
There is no way I can't afford to offend you both inside and outside. This is the only way I can protect myself wisely.
There was a lot of discussion in Lingxiao Palace.
"You don't know anything after a flash of golden light?"
"Although Marshal Tianpeng is not a top expert, he still has the cultivation level of Taiyi Golden Immortal. How could he pass out without even seeing his opponent clearly?"
"The Great Emperor Jinwu is a Daluo Jinxian, with extremely powerful magic. What kind of methods did this person from the lower world use, or is it someone who is deliberately plotting against me in heaven?"
...
However, the Queen Mother only cared about those three harsh words.
Prince Consort.
The Queen Mother said sternly: "Yaoji violated the laws of heaven and married a mortal, and you actually called this person your consort?"
Bian Zhuang suddenly raised his head and realized that he had spilled the beans, so he slapped his mouth lightly, "I, Bian Zhuang, said the wrong thing, and the Queen Mother will punish me."
At this time, Haotian spoke and said: "Okay, Tianpeng seems to have suffered a lot of damage in the lower realm this time, so don't embarrass him. Have you ever seen the mortal Yang Yi take action?"
Bian Zhuang shook his head and said bluntly: "I don't know."
The Queen Mother's expression became even more ugly. She glanced at Bian Zhuang coldly, her eyes like a knife, which sent chills down Bian Zhuang's back.
"I don't know what to ask, Marshal Tianpeng, what do you want me to say about you?"
There was undisguised anger in the Queen Mother's voice.
At this time, a palace maid came to the Queen Mother and said something. When the Queen Mother heard it, her eyes gradually became sharp, "Emperor of Heaven, I heard that Yao Ji has gone to heaven?"
Haotian didn't mean to hide anything, and said bluntly: "This is true, she has been imprisoned by me in the Pixiang Palace."
